description: Iteration 2 from s00: faster discharge (M1/M5/M6), much stronger red running and early start (M3/M2/M4), sidewalk-heavy seeking with less right-lane use (M10a/M9a), longer box hold (M7a).

driver_archetypes.rationale: M1/car 0.35 s (sim 0.74) and M5/length: tau 0.5, minGap 1.0 and accel 3.5 shorten discharge headway and queue growth; the earlier tau/minGap changes alone barely moved it, so accel is raised too.
Small car group for the right_lane option, M9a (sim 1.0-1.9 vs 0.57): share cut from 0.08 to 0.05 so fewer cars block the right-turn lane.

M1/moto 0.30 s (sim 0.45-0.49) and M5/moto_density: tau 0.4 and accel 6 shorten headway; minGapLat 0.45 and lower lcPushy reduce density and lane collisions; arbitrary alignment gave M4/lat_moto closest to 7.19 m in it01_s02.
Slow lane-centre riders (behaviour 10), kept from s00 which had the best M6/approach/s/moto (37.8 s vs 35.7 s).
Straight riders that may use the sidewalk or right lane: share 0.30 (was 0.18) to lift M10a/per_cycle from 0.1 toward 0.56.
M7a n_waiting (sim 1.4-2.6 vs 5.6) and M7c slope: impatience 1.0 gave the fewest waiters and lowest slope in s00, so it is lowered to 0.4 so riders wait in the box, with jmTimegapMinor 0.7.

traci_rules.rationale: M2/early/moto 0.13 (sim 0.017, only about 0.1 of p reaches the line) and M4/overshoot_share (sim 0): p 0.6 and a 10 s window with a slow creep 1.5 m/s put front-row riders past the stop line at green onset.
M2/early/car 0.011 (sim 0): effective rate is about 0.1 of p, so p 0.12.
M3/share/moto 0.098 and M3/per_cycle 3.9 (sim 0.007 and 0.3): about 0.12 of p0 realises, so p0 rises from 0.06 to 0.6; small k keeps M3/var_to_mean near 1.1.
M3/share/car 0.0041 (sim 0): realised rate about 0.12 of p0, so p0 0.03, no swarm effect.

p_wrong_lane 0 because it is inapplicable (no_option draws wasted); p_sidewalk 0.28 and v_creep 5 target M10a/per_cycle 0.56 (s00 gave 0.1 at 0.08, higher v_creep had higher counts); p_right_lane 0.025 targets M9a 0.57 and M9b/share_blocked 0.065.
M7a/release_time (sim -5..-1 s vs +2.8 s) and M6/junction/illegal_l (sim 23-27 s vs 36.8 s): longer hold of 2.5 s moves the exit later; kept below 4 s because M7b/clear_lag is already near 5.5 s.
Behaviour 10, M6/approach/s/moto: slow riders keep the lane centre, unchanged from s00.
